hebrew: הַטּוֹב, כִּי לֹא כָלוּ רַחֲמֶיךָ, וְהַמְרַחֵם, כִּי לֹא תַמּוּ חֲסָדֶיךָ, כּי מֵעוֹלָם קִוּינוּ לָךְ.
translation:
You are beneficent with boundless mercy and love. From of old we have always placed our hope in You.

Rabbinical Assembly 1961 Weekday Prayer Book (public domain)
information:
Eighteenth bracha of the Weekday Shmoneh Esrei.

Song is found on B'kol Echad, pg 84
